| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `neo acp` | start ACP (Agent Client Protocol) server |
| `neo mcp` | manage MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers |
| `neo [project]` | start neo tui |
| `neo attach <url>` | attach to a running neo server |
| `neo run [message..]` | run neo with a message |
| `neo debug` | debugging and troubleshooting tools |
| `neo auth` | manage AI providers and credentials |
| `neo agent` | manage agents |
| `neo upgrade [target]` | upgrade neo to the latest or a specific version |
| `neo uninstall` | uninstall neo and remove all related files |
| `neo serve` | starts a headless neo server |
| `neo web` | start neo server and open web interface |
| `neo models [provider]` | list all available models |
| `neo roll-call <filter>` | batch-test text models matching a filter for connectivity and latency |
| `neo profile` | show Neo account profile |
| `neo stats` | show token usage and cost statistics |
| `neo export [sessionID]` | export session data as JSON |
| `neo import <file>` | import session data from JSON file or URL |
| `neo github` | manage GitHub agent |
| `neo pr <number>` | fetch and checkout a GitHub PR branch, then run neo |
| `neo session` | manage sessions |
| `neo remote` | enable remote connection for real-time session relay |
| `neo daemon` | manage the local neo daemon |
| `neo console` | open or stop the local Neo Console |
| `neo db` | database tools |
| `neo config` | configuration tools |
| `neo plugin <module>` | install plugin and update config |
| `neo help [command]` | show full CLI reference |
| `neo completion` | generate shell completion script |
